about: One showcase slot per kind. Each slot offers two or three reference games for the creator to name one. Game facts are from memory unless DESIGN gives a number and its source; check them before the creator picks. The creator's choice, the showcase prompt and every result are added as new files (choices/, records/), never by editing this one.

slots.look: toon low-poly, pastel, bright light, physics bodies that flop

candidates.name: Peak
candidates.what: co-op climbing up a mountain with floppy bodies, stamina and items
candidates.whyFair: the best-selling silly co-op game of 2025 (7 million copies, DESIGN "Initial kinds"); short sessions that fit a browser slice
candidates.caveat: its fun comes from physics climbing, which the kit would build in the game

candidates.name: R.E.P.O.
candidates.what: co-op physics: carry fragile loot out of a haunted house with wobbly robots
candidates.whyFair: 16.4 million copies (DESIGN); the silly side of co-op horror; friends as visible characters is the whole joke
candidates.caveat: part horror, so it pulls toward the lofi kind

candidates.name: Chained Together
candidates.what: players chained to each other climb out of a pit; one falls, all fall
candidates.whyFair: one rule, readable in seconds; a clean test of silly bodies and shared fate
candidates.caveat: mostly one long climb; less to compare on look

slots.look: flat-shaded blocks, voxel or block avatars, saturated colours

candidates.name: Grow a Garden
candidates.what: plant, grow, sell and steal crops on your own plot in a shared server
candidates.whyFair: 21.6 million concurrent players in July 2025 (DESIGN); the blocky look as most players know it now
candidates.caveat: its pull is a saved economy over days, which a short blind session cannot show

candidates.name: Steal a Brainrot
candidates.what: buy creatures, defend your base, steal others' creatures
candidates.whyFair: 25.4 million concurrent (DESIGN); blocky avatars and bases
candidates.caveat: meme characters; a blind player may know it at once

candidates.name: Minecraft
candidates.what: build and survive in a world of blocks
candidates.whyFair: the origin of the block look; the yardstick for crisp block faces (T5's block-world line)
candidates.caveat: older than 2023 and a reference everyone knows, so it is never blind

slots.look: low polygons, low-resolution textures, dithering, vertex wobble, cel-shaded grime

likely.runtime: forge or three (with the lofi post pass)

candidates.name: Lethal Company
candidates.what: co-op scavenging on moons for a company quota while things hunt you
candidates.whyFair: the start of the lofi lineage: 100,000 concurrent in its first month, more than 10 million copies by January 2024 (DESIGN)
candidates.caveat: its voice chat and proximity horror are a big part of the feel

candidates.name: Content Warning
candidates.what: co-op: film scary things with a camera to go viral
candidates.whyFair: short sessions, cheap on purpose, a clear lofi look
candidates.caveat: the filming idea is its own mechanic

candidates.name: Buckshot Roulette
candidates.what: a tense table game with a shotgun and items, later with multiplayer
candidates.whyFair: one room, one table: a tight slice where look and tension carry everything
candidates.caveat: turns at a table, not movement; the multiplayer mode came later

slots.look: painterly stylised 3D: a house material, living grass, fog, a day cycle

candidates.name: Hades II
candidates.what: an action roguelike seen from above: rooms, boons, bosses
candidates.whyFair: painterly 3D look, a run of rooms and a boss: close to T4's request
candidates.caveat: single player; drawn-over 3D rather than a living world

candidates.name: Tunic
candidates.what: a small fox explores a stylised island seen from a high three-quarter camera
candidates.whyFair: the reference for the camera and the painterly island look
candidates.caveat: single player; older than 2023

candidates.name: Valheim
candidates.what: co-op survival in a stylised northern world with fog and a day cycle
candidates.whyFair: co-op in a scenic world with weather and light
candidates.caveat: survival crafting brings in systems a showcase slice would only sample

slots.look: grim fantasy: moonlit ruins, embers, ash

candidates.name: the private first-person reference game
candidates.what: the first-person co-op game the forge runtime's measured feel targets came from (named in the private notes)
candidates.whyFair: forge was built to play and feel like it, and its feel targets are already measured
candidates.caveat: not public: it can be played blind only on this machine, and its name stays out of public records

candidates.name: Elden Ring Nightreign
candidates.what: three-player co-op runs on a shrinking map with bosses
candidates.whyFair: the 2025 dark co-op run with bosses
candidates.caveat: a third-person action game from a big studio; an unfair look comparison in a short slice

candidates.name: Dark and Darker
candidates.what: first-person dungeon raids, PvPvE, extract with loot
candidates.whyFair: first-person dark fantasy with weight
candidates.caveat: PvP extraction loop; its fun needs other teams

slots.look: photoreal light, sea and sky; the place is the point

candidates.name: Tidewater
candidates.what: a calm photoreal coast with fishing and boats; MIT, its WebGPU core is the vista runtime's (credited)
candidates.whyFair: the vista runtime's own reference; a look pack of matched shots exists (T7)
candidates.caveat: our runtime runs its core, so it measures what we add more than the renderer

candidates.name: Dredge
candidates.what: fishing from a small boat among islands, with something wrong in the water
candidates.whyFair: fishing and boats; calm by day
candidates.caveat: single player; stylised rather than photoreal, and horror at night

candidates.name: Webfishing
candidates.what: hang out and fish with friends in a small lofi world
candidates.whyFair: fishing with friends: 10,000 concurrent in its first week (DESIGN)
candidates.caveat: its look is cheap and cosy, not photoreal

slots.look: 2D pixel art, 16 texels a metre, at most 32 colours a picture

candidates.name: Stardew Valley
candidates.what: farm, fish, mine and make friends in a pixel-art town
candidates.whyFair: still the reference for pixel art people play together
candidates.caveat: a long saved game; older than 2023

candidates.name: Core Keeper
candidates.what: co-op mining and building underground, seen from above
candidates.whyFair: pixel art with lighting, co-op from the start
candidates.caveat: survival crafting systems

candidates.name: Balatro
candidates.what: poker hands in a roguelike deck builder
candidates.whyFair: a pixel look with juice that holds attention on a still screen
candidates.caveat: single player and turn-based: friends would be a new thing

slots.look: 2D hand-drawn and cartoon, 128 texels a metre

candidates.name: Cuphead
candidates.what: run-and-gun boss fights in a 1930s cartoon style
candidates.whyFair: the reference for a hand-drawn look in motion
candidates.caveat: frame-by-frame animation is the bar; older than 2023

candidates.name: Slay the Spire 2
candidates.what: a deck-building roguelike, with co-op
candidates.whyFair: 568,884 concurrent at its peak (DESIGN)
candidates.caveat: turns and cards: movement and feel are about the cards

candidates.name: Hollow Knight: Silksong
candidates.what: a hand-drawn action platformer in a large connected world
candidates.whyFair: the 2025 reference for drawn art and feel
candidates.caveat: single player; very long
